完整文件哈希找出相同文件，多个时间点抽帧找出重新编码后的相似候选。只扫描就绪视频: Full-file hashes find identical files; frames sampled across the timeline find re-encoded similarity candidates. Scans cover ready videos and exclude the trash.

按拍摄日期、设备和画面尺寸自动归类，每五秒更新。分类只显示当前就绪视频，不移动文: Group by capture date, device and frame dimensions, updating every five seconds. Groups show current ready videos, exclude the trash and keep files in their folders.

使用拍摄信息中的日期。缺少拍摄时间的视频单独归类，不使用上传日期代替。: Uses dates from capture metadata. Videos without a capture time have their own group; upload dates are not substituted.

tag: 精确匹配标签；多个 tag: 要求同时包含各标签。含空格的标签用双引号: tag: matches an exact tag. Repeat tag: to require every tag. Wrap tags containing spaces in double quotes. Escape quotes and backslashes with a backslash.
rating: 支持 0–5 的整数；duration: 支持非负数，s 为秒、: rating: accepts integers from 0 to 5. duration: accepts nonnegative numbers with s for seconds, m for minutes or h for hours; no unit means seconds. Use >, >=, <, <= or =. No operator means equality.
普通关键词仍搜索标题、描述、原文件名和标签。2024 是关键词，不会自动限制拍摄: Keywords search titles, descriptions, original filenames and tags. 2024 is a keyword; use automatic groups to filter by capture year. Unknown prefixes remain keywords. Invalid recognized conditions display an error.
中文标题还支持全拼、分开的音节和首字母，例如「旅行日落」可搜 lvxingril: Chinese titles also match full pinyin, separate syllables and initials. For 旅行日落, try lvxingriluo, lv xing or lxrl. Pinyin ignores case and tone marks; type ü as v, ü or u:.
多音字按词组读音生成，特殊人名可能需用原文搜索。拼音结果保留中文标题并显示匹配提: Pronunciations follow the phrase dictionary; unusual names may need their original spelling. Results keep the Chinese title and indicate pinyin matches. Literal matches rank first. Search conditions still apply.

请先挂载硬盘并准备可写的空目录，或选择已有 ReelVault 存储目录。未连接: Mount the disk first and prepare a writable empty directory, or select an existing ReelVault storage directory. Disconnected disks will not be replaced with newly created directories. Update the path after remounting. Removing configuration keeps all files.
替换结果保存在原视频的存储位置。: Replacements stay in the original video’s storage location.
同一文件系统上的目录共用可用空间与预算，请勿相加。: Directories on the same filesystem share free space and reservations; do not add them together.
无法自动复制，请选择分享地址手动复制。: Cannot copy automatically. Select the share URL and copy it manually.
访客仅能浏览分享内容。合集分享随成员调整更新，只展示已就绪且未删除的视频。: Visitors can only browse shared content. Collection shares follow membership changes and show ready, undeleted videos.
关闭下载会隐藏并限制原文件下载入口。播放内容仍会发送到访客设备，无法阻止录屏或保: Disabling downloads hides and blocks original downloads. Playback data still reaches visitors; recording or saving playback data cannot be prevented.
在视频详情或合集页生成链接。撤销后新的访问、播放和下载请求立即失效；已发送的数据: Create links from video or collection pages. Revoking blocks new viewing, playback and download requests; data already delivered cannot be recalled.
视频暂时无法播放，请刷新或联系分享者。: This video cannot play right now. Refresh or contact the person who shared it.
分享中暂无可播放的视频: No playable videos in this share
登录时使用密码和验证器 App 的六位验证码。: Sign in with your password and a six-digit code from an authenticator app.
启用或关闭两步验证会退出其他设备。已登录的当前设备会保留。: Enabling or disabling two-step verification signs out other devices. This device stays signed in.
恢复码只显示这一次。请离线安全保存，每个恢复码只能使用一次。新恢复码会替换旧恢复: Recovery codes are shown only once. Store them safely offline; each code can be used once. New codes replace the old ones.
用验证器 App 扫描二维码，或手动输入密钥。设置在 10 分钟后过期。: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually. Setup expires after 10 minutes.
链接导入默认关闭，请在设置中启用。: Link import is off by default. Enable it in Settings.
服务器未安装可选的 yt-dlp 下载组件，请先按部署文档安装。: The optional yt-dlp downloader is not installed on the server. Follow the deployment guide to install it.
链接导入已加入任务中心，关闭此窗口后会继续运行。: Link import is queued in the task center. It will continue after this window closes.
仅导入一个视频。请确保有权下载，并遵守版权和来源站点的服务条款。: Import one video. Make sure you have permission to download it and follow copyright and the source site’s terms.
支持公开的 HTTP/HTTPS 视频地址，本机、内网和保留地址默认禁止。: Public HTTP/HTTPS video URLs are supported. Local, private and reserved addresses are blocked by default.
最大视频 {{size}}，运行超时 {{minutes}} 分钟；下载完成后自: Maximum video size {{size}}, running timeout {{minutes}} minutes. Playback resources are generated after download.
我确认有权下载此视频，并遵守版权与站点条款: I have permission to download this video and will follow copyright and the site’s terms
可选功能，默认关闭。仅下载你有权使用的视频，并遵守来源站点的服务条款。: An optional feature, off by default. Download only videos you have permission to use and follow the source site’s terms.
提交时会按大小上限预留下载和处理空间。关闭仅阻止新任务，已提交的任务可在任务中心: Submitting reserves download and processing space based on the size limit. Turning this off stops new tasks; cancel submitted tasks in the task center.
未安装 yt-dlp，无法导入链接: yt-dlp is not installed; link import is unavailable
下载临时文件超过限制: Download temporary files exceeded the limit
下载源没有提供可导入的视频: The source did not provide an importable video
下载文件路径无效: The download file path is invalid
下载视频超过大小限制或内容为空: The downloaded video exceeds the size limit or is empty
下载内容不包含可导入的视频: The download does not contain an importable video
目标文件夹已删除: The destination folder has been deleted
下载源不能访问本机、内网或保留地址: The download source cannot access local, private or reserved addresses
无法连接下载源: Cannot connect to the download source
记录登录、视频删除和升级结果。密码、验证码、会话及采集令牌不会写入审计记录。: Records sign-ins, video deletion and upgrades. Passwords, verification codes, sessions and scrape tokens are excluded.
保留 {{days}} 天，最多 {{count}} 条；当前筛选共 {{tot: Retained for {{days}} days, up to {{count}} entries; {{total}} match this filter.
指标采集默认关闭，管理员可按部署文档设置独立采集令牌。任务耗时统计包含暂停时间；: Scraping is disabled by default. Administrators can configure a separate scrape token using the deployment guide. Job duration includes pauses; jobs canceled while queued have no duration sample.
大文件按需生成浏览器兼容副本，原文件保留。可使用 HLS 播放，或生成兼容缓存；: Large videos get a browser-compatible copy on demand while keeping the original. Use HLS or generate this cache; prepare the cache before sharing.
清理后需要重新生成缓存，现有分享也会暂时无法播放。: After clearing, regenerate the cache to play this video. Existing shares will also be temporarily unavailable.
此视频需要兼容播放缓存或 HLS，准备好后即可播放。: Prepare a compatible playback cache or HLS to play this video.
播放缓存尚未就绪，请联系分享者生成兼容播放缓存。: Playback cache is unavailable. Ask the owner to prepare a compatible playback cache.
源视频已变化，请重新生成播放缓存: The source changed. Generate a new playback cache.
源视频已变化，播放缓存未保存: The source changed; playback cache was not saved.
在服务器本地识别语音，生成可切换字幕。搜索字幕内容可直接跳到对应句子。: Recognize speech locally on your server and generate selectable subtitles. Search subtitle text to jump to a sentence.
管理员尚未启用本地语音转写。已添加的字幕仍可进行内容搜索。: Local transcription is disabled. You can still search attached subtitles.
本地转写组件未安装，请查看部署说明。: The local transcription component is not installed. See the deployment guide.
源视频已变化，原转写不参与搜索，请重新转写。: The source video changed. Transcribe again to include it in content search.
移除生成的字幕轨道与搜索索引，手动添加的字幕保留。: Remove the generated subtitle track and search index. Manually attached subtitles are kept.
搜索已添加或转写的字幕，点击时间点播放对应句子。不同词语须出现在同一字幕片段。: Search attached or transcribed subtitles. Click a timestamp to play the sentence. All keywords must occur in the same segment.
可组合 tag:、rating:、duration: 条件，所有条件同时满足。: Combine tag:, rating: and duration: filters. All conditions must match.
输入语句或关键词查找字幕内容。: Enter a sentence or keywords to search subtitles.
没有匹配字幕。可在视频详情中转写语音或添加字幕。: No matching subtitles. Transcribe speech or attach subtitles on the video page.
视频没有音轨: This video has no audio track.
保存字幕与内容索引: Saving subtitles and the content index
源视频已变化或没有音轨，请重新提交转写: The source changed or has no audio. Submit transcription again.
源视频已变化，转写字幕未保存: The source video changed. Transcribed subtitles were not saved.
字幕时间超出源视频范围: Subtitle timestamps exceed the source timeline.
字幕单句过长: A subtitle sentence is too long.
本地语音模型未就绪，请先准备模型或允许下载: The local speech model is not ready. Prepare it first or enable model downloads.
源视频超过部署设置的转写时长上限: The source video exceeds the deployment’s transcription duration limit.
管理员尚未启用画面搜索。: The administrator has not enabled visual search.
视觉模型服务尚未就绪，请查看部署说明。: The vision model service is not ready. Check the deployment instructions.
源文件或模型已变化，请重新生成画面索引。: The source file or model has changed. Rebuild the visual index.
移除画面搜索索引和缓存图片，原视频保留。: Remove the visual search index and cached images. The original video is preserved.
达到画面数上限时会增大间隔以覆盖全片；短暂画面可能漏过。可缩短间隔并重新索引。: The interval increases at the frame limit to cover the whole video. Brief scenes can be missed. Use a shorter interval and rebuild the index.
抽取画面后，可用中文、英文描述或图片查找相似视频，并跳转到对应时间点。: After indexing frames, use Chinese or English descriptions or an image to find similar videos and jump to the matching time.
用中文、英文描述或图片查找相似画面。结果为近似匹配，相似度不是识别概率。: Find similar frames with Chinese or English descriptions or an image. Results are approximate; similarity is not a recognition probability.
例如：海边的日落: For example: a sunset by the sea
请选择不超过 10 MiB 的非空 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片。: Choose a nonempty PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 10 MiB.
先在视频详情中生成画面索引，再搜索视频库。: Build an index in a video’s details before searching the library.
还没有可搜索的画面。请先在视频详情中生成索引。: No searchable frames yet. Build an index in a video’s details first.
缩略图不可用，点击时间点查看匹配画面。: Thumbnail unavailable. Select the time to view the matching frame.
抽取视频画面并生成向量: Extracting video frames and encoding vectors
源视频已变化，请重新生成画面索引: The source video has changed. Rebuild its visual index.
源视频已变化，画面索引未保存: The source video has changed. The visual index was not saved.
画面已过期，请刷新: This frame has expired. Refresh the results.
根据抽样画面提出候选标签，需人工采纳。人脸分组可能出错，可手动纠正。: Suggest tags from sampled frames for your review. Face groups may be incorrect and can be corrected manually.
管理员尚未启用 AI 分析。: The administrator has not enabled AI analysis.
请先生成有效的画面索引。: Generate a valid visual index first.
分析结果已过期，请重新索引并分析。: The analysis has expired. Rebuild the visual index and analyze again.
输入 1 至 32 个候选标签，用逗号或换行分隔。: Enter 1–32 candidate tags, separated by commas or line breaks.
相似度不是概率；候选标签的选择会影响结果。短暂画面可能漏过。: Similarity is not a probability. Candidate tags affect the results, and brief scenes may be missed.
人脸模型尚未就绪，仍可分析场景标签。: The face model is not ready. Scene tag analysis is still available.
较高阈值减少误合并；同一画面中的人脸不会自动合并。: Higher thresholds reduce incorrect merges. Faces in the same frame are not grouped together automatically.
移除候选标签和人脸记录；已采纳的视频标签保留。: Remove suggested tags and face records. Accepted video tags are retained.
分组是模型建议，请人工核对。数量代表抽样画面中的人脸记录，不是人数。: Groups are model suggestions. Review them manually. Counts represent face observations in sampled frames, rather than unique people.
管理员尚未启用 AI 人脸分析。请在视频详情页生成画面索引并分析人脸。: AI face analysis has not been enabled. Generate a visual index and analyze faces on the video details page.
仅显示前 100 个目标分组，请搜索缩小范围。: Showing the first 100 destination groups. Search to narrow the results.
选择本页全部人脸: Select all faces on this page
没有符合条件的人脸记录或分组。: No matching face observations or groups.
这些记录将移到已忽略列表，可重新分组。: Move these observations to the ignored list. You can assign them to groups later.
将整个分组合并到目标，所有成员记为人工确认。: Merge the entire group into the destination and mark every observation as manually reviewed.
删除分组名称并忽略其中所有人脸，原视频保留。: Delete the group name and ignore all faces in it. Original videos are retained.
此操作会移除现有人脸记录和人工纠正，并使 AI 分析过期。已采纳的视频标签保留。: This removes existing face records and manual corrections, and expires AI analysis. Accepted video tags are retained.
画面索引已变化，请重新提交 AI 分析: The visual index has changed. Submit AI analysis again.
源文件或画面索引已变化，AI 结果未保存: The source file or visual index changed. AI results were not saved.
AI 分析完成，请复核标签与人脸分组: AI analysis complete. Review suggested tags and face groups.
人脸分组持续变化，请稍后重试；原分析结果保留: Face groups keep changing. Retry later. Previous analysis is retained.
人脸模型未启用或版本不兼容: The face model is disabled or incompatible.
索引缩略图缺失，请重新生成画面索引: Index thumbnails are missing. Rebuild the visual index.
使用独立访问密码，可读取整个视频库。请通过 HTTPS 或可信局域网连接，不使用: The separate access password grants read access to the entire library. Connect through HTTPS or a trusted local network; use this password instead of the administrator login password.
此密码仅显示一次，请保存到播放器。离开或刷新页面后无法查看。: This password is shown only once. Save it in your player; it cannot be viewed after leaving or refreshing this page.
请先生成播放器访问密码，再启用 WebDAV。: Generate a player access password before enabling WebDAV.
重置后旧密码立即失效；撤销会关闭访问。已开始的播放可能持续到下一次请求。: Resetting invalidates the old password immediately. Revoking disables access. Playback already in progress may continue until the next request.
默认关闭。播放器可只读浏览全部视频、文件夹与合集，播放原文件；格式兼容性取决于播: Off by default. Players can browse all videos, folders and collections with read-only access and play original files. Format support depends on the player.
容量未知。上传暂存与本地缓存使用主存储{{free}}；连接信息由部署环境配置，: Capacity unknown. Upload staging and the local cache use primary storage{{free}}; connection settings come from the deployment environment and cannot be changed here.
原视频保存在对象存储中，播放与下载直接读取。截图、设置封面、逐帧定位和读取内封字: The original is stored in object storage and is played and downloaded from there. Screenshots, setting a cover, frame-accurate seeking and reading embedded subtitles need a local copy; edits and other tasks download one automatically and release it when finished.
正在保存到对象存储，完成前保留本地文件。: Saving to object storage. The local file is kept until this finishes.
本地副本暂时保留，任务完成后会释放: Local copy kept temporarily; it is released when tasks finish
释放只删除本机副本，对象存储中的原视频保留；断网时需要本地副本才能播放和编辑。: Releasing deletes only the copy on this server; the original stays in object storage. Without network access, a local copy is needed to play or edit.
请先下载原视频本地副本: Download a local copy of the original first
对象存储前缀已属于其他视频库: The object storage prefix belongs to another video library
对象存储标识已绑定到其他地址: The object storage identity is bound to a different endpoint
对象存储标识文件无效: The object storage identity file is invalid
对象存储标识与此视频库不一致: The object storage identity does not match this video library
对象存储未配置或未绑定到此视频库: Object storage is not configured or not bound to this video library
未安装对象存储组件（s3 可选依赖）: The object storage component is not installed (optional s3 dependency)
